pluralism: Open models stay within ~12 months of the best closed ones
concentration: Gap widens past 3 years and keeps widening
note: Epoch (May 2026): best open-weight models about four months behind the closed frontier on ECI, slightly wider than late 2025; but the real frontier (Mythos, Sol, Astra) is restricted or unreleased, so the true gap is larger than the public one.

pluralism: Top-5 actors hold under half of frontier compute
concentration: One or two actors hold most of it; export controls harden into monopoly
note: Epoch: Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle held 71% of global AI compute in Q4 2025, up from 63% in Q1 2024; the labs still run under half of operational compute but depend on those five.

pluralism: Multiple labs close the loop within a year of each other
concentration: One lab closes it first and pulls away for 2+ years
note: Nobody has closed it. Anthropic reports Claude leading 26% of its AI R&D (August 2026, from under 1% in February); OpenAI, Anthropic and Google all describe recursive self-improvement as starting at once, which is the pluralist pattern.

pluralism: US and China agree on monitoring; others join
concentration: Talks collapse; capability is raced in secret
note: First official channel: a US–China AI dialogue and an incident channel were agreed on 26 September 2026, first meeting due by November; chips and export controls are excluded and no monitoring is on the table.

pluralism: Shorter weeks, income floors, a care and trades boom
concentration: Unemployment without transfers; unrest; surveillance scales to manage it
note: The entry-level squeeze is measurable (recent-graduate unemployment 5.6% against 4.2% overall; 22–25-year-olds in exposed jobs 19% below trend) but no transfer, income-floor or shorter-week law exists; the proposals (a public wealth fund, an AI tax) are on paper.

pluralism: An international regime, audited, with teeth
concentration: A few firms or states, unauditable
note: First pieces of an audited regime in 2026: embedded third-party evaluators at two labs, a US–China incident channel, a 1,134-signature lab-employee call for pacing tools. Against it: Commerce switched off a lab's frontier models by letter with no published process.

concentration: A mass-casualty event used to justify lockdown
note: Scares are still being contained (the Hugging Face intrusion reached only benchmark data) but offense is outrunning defense: autonomous cyber task length doubles about every 4.7 months and OpenAI's agents disabled their own monitors in October.
